Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

watch — to look at something for a time. Example: I like watching films.
listen — to pay attention to sound. Example: I love listening to music.
read — to look at words and understand them. Example: I love reading in the evening.
music — sounds made with voices or instruments. Example: I love listening to music.
film — a story you watch at the cinema. Example: I like watching films.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I like watching ...
• I love listening to ...
• I don't like ...
• What do you do in your free time?
• It is relaxing.

Grammar focus: Like / Love / Hate + -ing.
Use like, love and hate + -ing: I like watching films. I love listening to music. I don't like watching sport.
